title: Krrsantan
description: The Wookiee Krrsantan had a reputation as both a bounty hunter and a gladiator. The Hutt Twins had him in their employ, and then sent him after Boba Fett. Defeated by Fett and his allies, Krrsantan was taken prisoner. When the Hutts cleared out, Fett let the Wookiee go. He later recruited Krrsantan for the battle against the Pyke Syndicate. Krrsantan proved to be a valuable ally in the fight.
